description: A pie of labelled slices. Screen readers get a text summary per slice, and `showTable` adds a data table.

props.name: title
props.description: A heading above the chart, also its spoken name.

props.name: summaryTemplate
props.description: What a screen reader hears for each slice; `{label}`, `{value}` and `{percent}` are replaced.

props.name: showTable
props.description: Whether a table of the values is shown below the chart.
